about: Each IC on the NES-CPU-10 board: its reference (as the print reads it, task 3), role, pin count, package, and its GND and +5V (VCC) pins with the source each pinout was read from. Task 4 wrote what its nets check needs; task 5 adds each console's part. Facts read from the sources named, not their text.

ics.pinoutSource: nesdev wiki, "CPU pinout" (https://www.nesdev.org/wiki/CPU_pinout), read 5 October 2026: pin 20 GND, pin 40 +5V
nesdev wiki, "PPU pinout" (https://www.nesdev.org/wiki/PPU_pinout), read 5 October 2026: pin 20 GND, pin 40 +5V

Hitachi, "HM6116 Series, 2048-word x 8-bit High Speed CMOS Static RAM" data sheet, "Pin Arrangement", the 24-pin DIP (https://w140.com/tekwiki/images/b/bb/HM6116LP-4_CMOS_SRAM.PDF), read 5 October 2026: pin 12 Vss, pin 24 Vcc. The 6116 pinout is the same whoever made the part

Hitachi, "HM6116 Series, 2048-word x 8-bit High Speed CMOS Static RAM" data sheet, "Pin Arrangement", the 24-pin DIP (https://w140.com/tekwiki/images/b/bb/HM6116LP-4_CMOS_SRAM.PDF), read 5 October 2026: pin 12 Vss, pin 24 Vcc. The 6116 pinout is the same whoever made the part

Texas Instruments, "SN54HC373, SN74HC373 Octal D-Type Transparent Latches" data sheet (SCLS140G, revised February 2025), the pin functions table for the 20-pin PDIP (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74hc373.pdf), read 5 October 2026: pin 10 GND, pin 20 VCC. The board's print reads 74LS373 and the KiCad redrawing 74HC373; the '373 has one pinout in both families

Texas Instruments, "SNx4HC139 Dual 2-Line To 4-Line Decoders/Demultiplexers" data sheet (SCLS108E, revised February 2022), section 4 "Pin Configuration and Functions", the 16-pin PDIP (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74hc139.pdf), read 5 October 2026: pin 8 GND, pin 16 VCC. The board's print reads 74LS139; the '139 has one pinout in both families

Texas Instruments, "SN54HC368, SN74HC368" data sheet (SCLS310F, revised June 2022), section 4 "Pin Configuration and Functions", the 16-pin PDIP (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74hc368.pdf), read 5 October 2026: pin 8 GND, pin 16 VCC. The board's part is Toshiba's TC40H368, whose own data sheet was not found as text; logicroom.jp's "TC40H368" page (https://logicroom.jp/page/MOS/TC40H368.html), read the same day, says its pin assignment and function are the 74LS368's

port.why: U7 is pad1 and U8 pad2 by the board's print, "40H368(CI)" and "40H368(CII)"; that CI and CII are controller ports one and two, so the reads of $4016 and $4017, is inferred from the names, and task 6 checks it against the nesdev wiki

ics.pinoutSource: Texas Instruments, "SN54HCU04, SN74HCU04 Hex Inverters" data sheet (SCLS079E, revised March 2004), the 14-pin DIP (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74hcu04.pdf), read 5 October 2026: pin 7 GND, pin 14 VCC. The board's print reads 74HCU04P

nesdev wiki, "CIC lockout chip pinout" (https://www.nesdev.org/wiki/CIC_lockout_chip_pinout), read 5 October 2026: pin 8 Gnd, pin 16 +5V (Vcc). The page also shows pins 11 to 15 grounded in an NES; only pin 8, the chip's own ground, is used here
